paragraphs: Rav Chinena: “Rav said”—Bekhorot 32a. In R. Assi's name, and R. Assi in Shmuel bar Rav Yitzchak's name: Tamid 31b. Rav Acha the Tall taught before him. He and R. Yonatan asked R. Natan of the South. Inyani bar Nachshon [source ענינו]. See R. Parnakh.
